exam.subject: english
exam.title: Lesson 2｜What Are These?｜困難
exam.subtitle: 15 題｜整合判讀、比較與推論
exam.sourceNote: 依 115 學年度康軒版國中英文第一冊 Lesson 2 教材參考資料自編；題型參考 GEPT 初級整合式詞彙、結構與閱讀判讀四選一形式，非官方 GEPT 試題。

questions.q: A: What is this?  B: _____ an ox.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) It is。this 是單數，回答可用 It is an ox。

questions.q: A: What are those?  B: _____ mice.
questions.e: 答案是 (D) They are。those 為複數，mouse 的複數為 mice。
答案是 (D) These is a fox.。These 是複數，不能搭配 is，也不應接單數 a fox。

questions.q: One woman is here, and two _____ are over there.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) women。woman 的不規則複數是 women。

questions.q: One person is in the room. Five _____ are outside.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) people。教材列出 person → people / persons；一般情境下 people 最自然。

questions.q: Tom has two sisters. _____ names are Amy and Mia.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) Their。names 屬於兩位 sisters，所有格用 their。

questions.q: Which phrase means “那些女孩們的桌子”?
questions.e: 答案是 (C) those girls’ desks。girls 是複數，所有格在 s 後加 apostrophe。

questions.q: African elephants are about 3.2 meters tall, while Asian elephants are about 2.75 meters tall. Which inference is best supported?
o: African elephants are taller on average.
All African elephants have the same height.
questions.e: 答案是 (A)。3.2 大於 2.75，因此可由教材數據推論 African elephants 平均較高；其他選項沒有這段資料支持。

questions.q: Asian elephants live about 60 years and African elephants about 70 years. Which statement is supported?
o: Asian elephants live about 10 years longer.
African elephants live about 10 years longer.
The passage gives no lifespan information.
questions.e: 答案是 (B)。70 − 60 = 10，因此教材資料支持 African elephants 約多 10 年。

questions.q: A passage says, “This elephant has very big ears and is about 3.2 meters tall.” Based on Lesson 2, it is more likely a(n) _____.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) African elephant。大耳朵與約 3.2 meters 都符合教材中的 African elephant 特徵。

questions.q: Which question-answer pair is grammatically correct?
o: What is these? — These are lions.
What are this? — This is a lion.
What are they? — They are lions.
What is those? — Those are lions.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) What are they? — They are lions.。they 是複數，問答都使用 are。

questions.q: Which contraction is correct according to Lesson 2?
questions.e: 答案是 (B) what is → what’s。教材特別指出 what is 可縮寫；this is 不縮寫。

questions.q: Which two words begin with voiceless sounds taught in Lesson 2?
questions.e: 答案是 (A) pig — table。/p/ 與 /t/ 都是本課列出的清音；/b/、/d/ 為相對的濁音。

questions.q: The reading compares size, ears, height, and lifespan of two kinds of elephants. What is the main idea?
o: Differences between Asian and African elephants
questions.e: 答案是 (B)。教材 p.31–32 的主旨就是比較 Asian elephants 與 African elephants 的差異。

questions.q: When a reader uses facts in a passage plus background knowledge to decide something the writer does not say directly, the reader is _____.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) making an inference。Lesson 2 的 Reading Skills 是 Making Inferences：利用文本線索加上背景知識推論未明說資訊。
